title: Arashiyama
content:
From Saga-Arashiyama station to Tenryū-ji, a Zen temple whose garden pond dates from the 14th century, through the bamboo grove behind it, and down to the Togetsukyō bridge over the Katsura river.

Demo day: the walk is a simulated route along real streets. Photographs from Wikimedia Commons, credited in each caption.
